evals.prompt: Ask Claude to review our local git diff for race conditions and return actionable feedback.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the diff to Claude using `git diff | ai --claude -n '...'` or `ai --claude -n '...'` with fresh context flag.
expectations: Includes the '-n' flag to ensure a clean conversation thread
Pipes the git diff or passes it clearly to the prompt

evals.prompt: Verify this NP-hard scheduling proof using DeepSeek's deep thinking reasoning mode.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses `ai --deepseek --think '...'` to engage DeepSeek-R1's chain-of-thought.
expectations: Includes the '--think' flag to engage R1 reasoning
Avoids mention of internal WebSocket or CDP mechanics

evals.prompt: Generate a photorealistic cyberpunk street scene image and save it as cyberpunk.png.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes `ai --gemini --imgen '...' -o cyberpunk.png` or `ai --mistral --imgen '...' -o cyberpunk.png`.
expectations: Uses '-o cyberpunk.png' to specify the output path
Selects an image-capable provider such as Gemini, Mistral, Meta, or ChatGPT

evals.prompt: Check the health and readiness across all active frontier AI providers.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes `ai --all-check` to display the readiness status table.
expectations: Understands how to interpret READY vs OFFLINE statuses
